clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/insert with schema containing JSON dataType field, passing plain string value: {"meta": "plain_string"}
clean_repro.observed: Server returns HTTP 200 success, accepting plain string for JSON dataType field instead of requiring JSON object/array

verified_assumptions: JSON dataType field should only accept valid JSON structures (objects or arrays)
Plain strings are not valid JSON unless they represent JSON primitives
Type coercion from string to JSON should be explicit, not implicit

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_type_json_041 - Valid dataType value: JSON
JSON field semantic: should store JSON data, not arbitrary strings

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 Insert → checkAndSetData(body) → gjson.GetBytes parses JSON → anyToColumns(rows, schema) → line 1968 does candi.v.Interface().([]byte) for JSON type without format validation
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 insert对JSON字段(line 1968)直接做字节转换,缺少JSON格式校验。当传入纯字符串'plain_string'时,应验证JSON格式并拒绝非JSON值,但实际服务端接受了无效数据,构成真缺陷。

falsification.probe: Query the inserted record to verify invalid JSON was accepted: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/query with outputFields including meta field
falsification.observed: Query confirms the record was stored with plain string value intact, demonstrating lack of JSON validation

excluded: Feature not documented (JSON dataType is well-documented)

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types
cognition_match.note: 命中REST v2类型处理盲点: JSON字段缺少格式验证,属于开发者已识别的系统性类型处理问题。

verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 insert对JSON字段缺少格式验证,接受纯字符串'plain_string'而非要求有效的JSON结构。源码接地发现line 1968处直接字节转换缺少校验逻辑。实测复现证实服务端返回HTTP 200成功,query验证确认无效数据已存储,构成真缺陷。此缺陷命中REST v2类型处理盲点模式。

contract.explicit_requirement: JSON dataType fields should only accept valid JSON structures (constraint_id: milvus_type_json_041)

physical.objective_constraint: JSON fields have physical format constraint - must be valid JSON (object/array/primitive), not arbitrary strings
